five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.current_su_ke_lai_pattern: Serialized prefixes ('Rạch Gầm 1785 P2: Cổ Chai Thới Sơn & Pháo Trên Bùn') signal to cold swipe-feed viewers that they missed Part 1, causing immediate swipe-away.
five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.viral_100k_1m_pattern: 100% of the 15 breakout Shorts (91K-3.59M views) use standalone mass-curiosity titles (<= 55 chars, zero 'P1/P2/P3' prefix) that any cold Vietnamese viewer understands in 1.5 seconds.

five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.current_su_ke_lai_pattern: 17-18 syllable hooks loaded with 2-3 unfamiliar micro-toponyms ('Cù lao Thới Sơn', 'Đồn Trà Tân', 'Sông An Đức') in the first 2.5 seconds.
five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.viral_100k_1m_pattern: 0.0-2.5s Instant Curiosity Hook strictly <= 16 syllables, zero obscure geography jargon, zero [pause:...], anchoring on a household folk saying, a visceral life-or-death choice, an elite weapon, or a 1v1 commander comparison.

five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.current_su_ke_lai_pattern: 6 consecutive Shorts slicing a single river battle (Rạch Gầm 1785) into narrow technical sub-steps.
five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.viral_100k_1m_pattern: Rotates across the 5 Proven Viral Content Pillars: (1) Folk-Saying Decoder, (2) 1v1 Emperor/Commander Ranking, (3) Elite Đại Việt Military Unit / Secret Weapon, (4) Life-or-Death Deception / Historical Mystery, (5) Tragic Post-Victory Destiny.

five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.current_su_ke_lai_pattern: Single fixed ~100s 20-beat template used for every topic regardless of cognitive density.
five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.viral_100k_1m_pattern: Dual-Duration Pacing Router: Mode A+ ('viral_fast_loop_short', 54-72s / 55-75s, 15-16 beats @ ~3.8s/beat) for >95% APV replay loops on single weapons/idioms (CD Media 456K model), and Mode B ('serialized_detail_short', 105-145s / 115-145s, 20-24 beats) for 3-case rankings & heroic sagas (Dòng Máu Việt 761K-3.59M model).

five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.current_su_ke_lai_pattern: Informational cliffhanger ending ('Xem Phần 3 trên Sử Kể Lại') that informs but does not provoke comment debate.
five_root_cause_gaps_vs_current_su_ke_la.viral_100k_1m_pattern: Final 15% + Pinned Creator Comment pose a polarizing 2-choice historical judgment question (driving >0.15% comment/view ratio while the video loops behind the open comment drawer).

hook_formulas_v4.structural_template_vi: Vì sao dân Việt [hành động/câu nói quen] trước [nhân vật/sự kiện] đúng [con số]?

hook_formulas_v4.structural_template_vi: [Con số] vị [vua/danh tướng] Việt Nam nào [hành động phi thường] mà chưa từng [thất bại]?

hook_formulas_v4.structural_template_vi: Không tốn [vũ khí nhỏ], [danh tướng] lấy trọn [mục tiêu lớn] chỉ trong [thời gian].
